description: Redesign DashboardLayout to use MonitoringNav for public users (replacing the heavy sidebar) and restyle the sidebar for admin users with landing page tokens, 28px radius, soft active highlight, and a small role chip. Remove redundant guest messaging (purple badge, info banner, footer card).
steps: Open frontend/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx and import MonitoringNav from '@/components/layout/MonitoringNav'

At top of DashboardLayout component body, compute: const userRole = getUserRole(isAuthenticated, user); const isPublicUser = userRole === 'public'; const isAdminUser = userRole === 'admin' || user?.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' || user?.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN'; (keep existing role detection logic)

Add conditional rendering: if (isPublicUser) { return (
{children}
); }

For admin layout (existing sidebar code path), update sidebar styling: change background from colors.sidebarBackground to 'var(--landing-surface)', border from getBorderColor() to '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius from DESIGN_SPACING.borderRadius.lg to '28px'
Replace solid green active background (colors.activeBackground) with 'var(--landing-soft)' for active nav items

Replace the uppercase role badge (purple for PUBLIC_VIEWER, green for Administrator) with a small chip: 14px text, color 'var(--landing-mute)', border '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius '999px', padding '4px 12px', background 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' or transparent, no uppercase transform
Apply same styling changes to mobile sidebar (the .mobile-sidebar overlay section)
Remove any inline references to purple (#C084FC) or neon green (#39FF88) solid backgrounds for badges — replace with subtle chip styling
acceptance_criteria: Public users (not logged in) see MonitoringNav at top, no sidebar, no purple 'PUBLIC VIEWER' badge
Admin users (SYSTEM_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN) see restyled sidebar with var(--landing-surface) background, 28px border-radius, 1px solid var(--landing-line) border
Admin sidebar active link has var(--landing-soft) background (soft green highlight), not solid neon green
Admin role badge is a small subtle chip (14px text, muted color, pill shape), not an uppercase card
Mobile sidebar (< 1024px) has same styling as desktop sidebar
Collapsible sidebar still works for admins (expand/collapse button functions correctly)
No purple badge, no uppercase 'PUBLIC VIEWER' or 'ADMINISTRATOR' cards
verification: Run 'npm run build' — build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Start dev server, open http://localhost:5173/dashboard in incognito mode (not logged in) — MonitoringNav renders at top, no sidebar visible
Log in as SYSTEM_ADMIN (use /admin/login), navigate to /dashboard — sidebar renders on left with new styling (soft green highlight on active link, small role chip, 28px radius)
Click collapse button in admin sidebar — sidebar collapses to icon-only, role chip shows single letter or icon
Resize browser to < 1024px — hamburger menu appears, click it, mobile sidebar slides in with same styling
Check with DevTools Elements inspector: sidebar has style='background: var(--landing-surface); border: 1px solid var(--landing-line); borderRadius: 28px'
Active nav link in sidebar has background: var(--landing-soft), NOT a solid green color
